anchor: Their scaling is predominantly reactive (queue depths, utilization, arrival rates); the one exception, ElasticMM, adds only a static allocation of idle instances by a long-run burst-tolerance heuristic over aggregate load, not a per-pool demand forecast
claim_text: Scaling in these systems is predominantly reactive (queue depths, utilization, arrival rates); ElasticMM adds only static allocation of idle instances via long-run burst-tolerance heuristic over aggregate load, not per-pool demand forecast.

anchor: In their default model-serving configurations, all watch the one request stream
claim_text: In default model-serving configurations, Kubernetes HPA, KEDA, Knative KPA all watch the single request stream.

anchor: On the demand side, load became burstier and less stationary
claim_text: Load became burstier and less stationary.

anchor: its predictive loop still watches a single averaged text-side stream, a limitation its own design notes state.
claim_text: Dynamo's predictive loop watches single averaged text-side stream, a limitation noted in its design.

anchor: All are text-centric: their request descriptors are token counts and timestamps.
claim_text: All public LLM traces are text-centric with request descriptors as token counts and timestamps.
